Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art fighter SPRITE ATLAS for Sandbox Wars, a cyberpunk street-fighting game. Make one ORIGINAL human character, unofficial provider-inspired concept. STYLE: high-quality 16-bit arcade pixel art, sharp square pixel clusters, stepped dark contours, restricted shading ramps. No painterly blur, no smooth vector cartoon, no 3D render.
LAYOUT: square PNG, true transparent background, EXACTLY nine images in a strict 3x3 grid of equal square cells. No text, labels, grid lines, background, floor or cast shadow. Each figure must fit INSIDE its cell with 7% transparent margin on ALL edges, including top and bottom. Figures never touch across cells. All full-body sprites face RIGHT in three-quarter view. Same body scale across six idle frames and standing victory, boots at same baseline, max height 80% of cell. Rows one and two contain six subtly differing CLEAN idle frames of identical character. Bottom left battered defeat, bottom middle battered victory, bottom right enlarged clean head-and-shoulders portrait of same character. Portrait contained in its cell. Maintain identical clothes, proportions, colors and face across all nine. Damage only in bottom-left and bottom-middle; no blood or gore. Gear stays attached, no detached props or particles.
CHARACTER: DOCKER, the old harbor bruiser. Broad barrel-chested middle-aged human sailor, massive bare forearms, weathered cheerful face, short salt-and-pepper beard, saturated royal BLUE knitted sailor beanie. Cropped open blue dock jacket with rolled short sleeves, white and navy striped undershirt stretched over round chest. Rectangular shipping-container-like reinforcement blocks on jacket shoulders. Dark blue loose work trousers, sturdy black boots. Simple blue WHALE tattoo clearly readable along exposed near forearm. Small cyan circuitry integrated into shoulder blocks and wrist wraps gives CYBERPUNK port-worker feel. A human street fighter with whale-inspired bulk, NOT actual whale or whale helmet. Friendly old sailor muscle, no giant robot arms, no industrial vest, no orange gear.
IDLE SIX FRAMES: grounded broad-footed stance, one hand slowly tightens the wrap around the opposite fist at belly height, shoulders gently roll; relaxed veteran grin. Six SMALL changes form subtle loop, no walking or attack.
BATTERED DEFEAT bottom left: sitting on ground, boots forward, shoulders slumped, beanie slipped over one eye, one hand nursing sore jaw, small adhesive cheek bandage, scuffed jacket.
BATTERED VICTORY bottom middle: standing wearily with broad grin, modestly flexing whale-tattooed forearm at shoulder height, other hand rests on aching lower back, beanie askew, same minor scuffs and bandage. Keep entire raised arm within padding.
PORTRAIT bottom right: clean cheerful weathered sailor face with blue beanie, salt-pepper beard, striped shirt, blue jacket and rectangular shoulder plates. No damage.
Palette saturated Docker-like blue, white, navy, warm skin, tiny cyan accents. Round broad silhouette. Sprite atlas only.

CHARACTER: BOAT, a lanky human female cyberpunk canal smuggler in her thirties, angular mischievous face, short dark side-swept hair, weathered NAVY fisherman captain cap with tiny brass fastener. Tall thin silhouette. Long open SLEEVELESS waterproof weathered navy coat ending below knees, CREAM lining and asymmetrical lapels, plain cream fitted vest beneath, rolled slate trousers showing ankles, battered low deck shoes. One exposed natural arm, one slim mechanical brass-and-dark-steel forearm with compact circular winch built into wrist, cable fully coiled flush inside forearm. Subtle cyan indicator on wrist, no detached rope, no weapon. Muted brass coat buckles, small cream sail-shaped patch on chest. Human underground street punk captain, not pirate fantasy: no tricorne, eyepatch, sword, anchor, peg leg, beard or blue sailor stripes. No huge armor or bulky gauntlets. Navy and CREAM dominate with muted BRASS accents, only tiny cyan light. This must feel like cyberpunk docks, not historical maritime cosplay.
IDLE SIX FRAMES: upright loose narrow stance, knees slightly bent, natural hand hooks thumb in coat lapel, mechanical hand resting low at hip. Gentle heel-to-toe weight shift and coat sway, smug half-smile. Feet essentially planted, six subtly different loop frames, no attacks.
BATTERED DEFEAT bottom left: kneeling awkwardly with long coat tangled around legs, cap flattened crooked on head, natural hand braces ground, mechanical forearm across knee, annoyed face with small cheek adhesive bandage, scuffed coat.
BATTERED VICTORY bottom middle: standing painfully straight giving a comically formal captain salute with natural hand, mechanical hand holding sore ribs, flattened crooked cap, weary proud smile, same scuffs and cheek bandage. Entire salute stays within cell margins.
PORTRAIT bottom right: clean mischievous angular female face, short dark hair, navy fisherman cap, cream lapels and navy sleeveless coat. No injuries.
Keep her unmistakably lanky and distinct from a broad blue sailor. Sprite atlas only.
